scenes.say: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning?
head: WHAT IF EARTH
*STOPPED*
SPINNING?

scenes.say: Right now, the ground under your feet moves at about one thousand six hundred and seventy kilometers per hour.
head: YOU ARE MOVING
*RIGHT NOW*
scenes.label: speed at the equator

scenes.say: If the planet stopped, the atmosphere would not.
head: THE PLANET
*STOPS*
scenes.label: The air keeps going

scenes.say: Winds faster than any hurricane. Oceans rushing toward the poles. Cities wiped clean.
And one day would no longer last twenty four hours. It would last an entire year.
head: HOW LONG IS
*ONE DAY?*

scenes.say: Half the planet would bake under the Sun, while the other half would freeze in endless night.
head: HALF FIRE
*HALF ICE*

scenes.say: The good news? Physics says this is almost impossible.
scenes.sublabel: Earth is slowing by about 2 ms per century

scenes.say: But here, anything is possible. Welcome to Parallel Earth.
head: ANYTHING IS
*POSSIBLE*

scenes.say: Would you survive in this timeline? Follow for more.
head: WOULD YOU
SURVIVE IN THIS
*TIMELINE?*
